specification.hypothesis: under equal evaluation envelopes, shared consolidated Reflex improves unseen unary u8 semantic Campaigns more than isolated Bootstrap
specification.development_corpus: all x xor c semantics plus the first 8190 enumerated add/rotate pilot groups
specification.training_generator: 96 refuted Seeds xor(input,c) for c=1..96 followed by 96 useful Seeds xor(xor(xor(input,c),0),0) for c=97..192
specification.pilot_generator: lexicographic c1=1..255,r=1..7,c2=1..255; base=rotl(add(rotl(add(input,c1),r),c2),r); accepted ordinal category cycles [xor(base,31),xor(base,0),xor(xor(base,0),0)]; stop after 8190 observed cases
specification.audit_generator: sha256(seed || little-endian counter) rejection sampling into globally unique add/rotate truth-table groups; ordinal-balanced surface categories
specification.audit_surface_categories: bytes map to c1=(b0 mod 255)+1,r1=(b1 mod 7)+1,c2=(b2 mod 255)+1,r2=(b3 mod 7)+1; accepted ordinal category cycles [xor(base,31),xor(base,0),xor(xor(base,0),0)] where base=rotl(add(rotl(add(input,c1),r1),c2),r2)
specification.semantic_group_digest: sha256('reflex-u8-semantic-function-v1\0' || outputs for inputs 0..255 in ascending order)
specification.semantic_split: reject every xor(input,c) truth-table group, every observed pilot truth-table group, and every audit group accepted by an earlier replicate
specification.audit_exposure: build and validate all training and ablation bundles before generating any audit corpus; execute immediately after generation and publish every record
specification.ablations: full=trained bundle; no-model=identical full bundle with Learning state and Model Revision ID from a production-created Bootstrap bundle; no-derived=identical full bundle with Derived Operators removed and canonical Knowledge Revision ID recomputed; bootstrap=fresh isolated production Runtime
specification.primary_outcome: paired comparison of aggregate node count across exactly 8190 audit-origin Pareto Artifacts; lower is better
specification.uncertainty: 10000 deterministic paired bootstrap resamples; Bonferroni-adjusted one-sided percentile lower bounds at family-wise 99% confidence
specification.bootstrap_algorithm: for each comparison and resample/draw, index=u16_le(sha256('reflex-paired-bootstrap-v1\0'||treatment||u64_le(resample)||u64_le(draw))[0..2]) mod 10; integer mean; sorted lower bound index=floor(10000/(100*3))
specification.multiplicity: three contrasts at alpha=0.01/3; all must exceed their threshold and every paired effect must be positive
specification.stopping: execute every assigned process exactly once; no outcome-dependent stopping
specification.exclusions: none; crashes, timeouts, malformed results, and deviations are retained and prevent confirmation
specification.decision: confirm only if full beats Bootstrap and both one-factor ablations above practical thresholds, all protected aggregates do not regress pairwise, every assignment recovers identically, and no Protocol Deviation occurs
specification.mode: frozen evaluation; post-audit adaptation is discarded
specification.pareto_scope: analyze exactly final Pareto Artifacts whose origin key is one of the replicate's audit Seeds; training Artifacts are excluded from outcomes
specification.anytime_trace: record audit-origin Pareto aggregate totals at observer sequence 1, every 256th sequence, and the final sequence
specification.recovery: resume each completed output with the same Seeds and a 1000000-request replay envelope; stop at initial observer delivery; require StoppedByObserver plus identical audit count, aggregates, and Artifact-key digest
